title: React Query Mutations Quiz
description: Test your understanding of React Query mutations and best practices

questions.explanation: useMutation is designed for server mutations - operations that modify data on the server like POST, PUT, DELETE requests.
questions.question: What is the primary purpose of useMutation in React Query?

questions.explanation: useQuery is used for data fetching, while useMutation is for server mutations that modify data.
questions.question: Which hook would you use to fetch data on component mount?

questions.explanation: invalidateQueries marks affected queries as stale, causing them to refetch fresh data from the server.
options: Marks queries as stale to trigger refetch
